name: Ashtanga Yoga Bolivia (Santa Cruz de la Sierra)
reason: Too thin: its own site (ashtangayogabolivia.com; robots.txt allows us) is one teacher's Mysore programme (Mariana Suárez, Level 1 authorised) with a single classes-and-timetable page as its only offering page; the beginners' course, led and online classes have no pages of their own, no prices could be read, and there is no training, workshop or free resource. Published email info@ashtangayogabolivia.com. Could become an individual listing for Mariana Suárez later.
